📊 $HOOD Q3 2026 EARNINGS RECAP 📉

Robinhood reported mixed earnings yesterday, sending shares down roughly 5–7% in after-hours trading.

💰 THE NUMBERS

🟢 Revenue: $1.42B (+12% YoY)
🔴 Revenue Estimate: $1.44B — MISS
🔴 GAAP EPS: $0.51 — MISS
🟢 Adjusted EPS: $0.60 — BEAT
🔴 Net Income: $476M (-14% YoY)

📈 BUSINESS BREAKDOWN

🔴 Crypto Revenue: $120M (-55% YoY)
🟢 Options Revenue: $399M (+31% YoY)
🟢 Equities Revenue: $121M (+41% YoY)
🟢 Prediction Markets: $173M (6x+ YoY)
🟢 Gold Subscribers: 5.2M (+34% YoY)

🚨 WHY THE STOCK DROPPED

Crypto revenue took a massive hit, profitability declined, and total revenue missed expectations.

Investors were expecting stronger growth.

🔥 THE BULLISH CASE

Robinhood’s business is expanding beyond traditional stock and crypto trading.

Prediction markets are becoming a serious revenue driver, options activity remains strong, and Gold subscriptions continue growing.

The company is building multiple revenue streams that could support long-term growth.

🎯 MY OUTLOOK

I’m still bullish on HOOD long term.

The earnings reaction could create an attractive buying opportunity, but I want to see where buyers step in before committing capital.

I’m personally watching HOOD as a potential 100-share position for long-term appreciation and covered-call income.

A quality entry matters more than catching the exact bottom.

text:
$SMCI — BOUGHT 32 SHARES @ $31.45 📈

Started a position in SMCI following earnings. The company reported $19.9B in revenue, nearly 300% year-over-year growth, while adjusted EPS climbed to $1.81 from $0.35. Those are impressive numbers, and I believe the market is overlooking the long-term opportunity.

What makes me bullish is the continued demand for AI infrastructure. Everyone focuses on NVIDIA and AMD, but SMCI supplies the servers, liquid cooling systems, and infrastructure needed to power AI data centers. As hyperscalers continue investing billions into AI, SMCI is positioned to benefit.

Management is projecting $72B–$82B in FY2027 revenue, which tells me the growth story could have plenty of room left. My biggest concerns are margin pressure and cash flow, but if management can improve execution, I believe the stock has significant upside potential.

At $31.45, I like the risk/reward for a longer-term position. I’m buying shares because I believe AI infrastructure spending will continue expanding over the next several years. I’ll be watching margins, cash flow, and future guidance closely as the thesis develops. @everyone
